title: Remains of the Necrolord
start: Speak to Death in the City of Um.

items.t: Ghostspeak amulet or cramulet (unless hard Morytania achievements are complete)

rewards.l: Necromancy XP lamp (Remains of the Necrolord)
Dungeoneering XP lamp (Remains of the Necrolord)

steps.t: Talk to Death in the City of Um. [Chat: Accept]
Talk to the following three listless dead around Daemonheim to free them:

sub.t: West of the fountain south of the ring of kinship's teleport location.
Beside the entrance to the Kal'gerion resource dungeon (Dungeoneering cape teleport [Chat: 0 More... › 9 Kal'gerion demon dungeon]).
Along the east coast, at the Marmaros & Gorgonite Mine north of the Fremennik ship (Shadow reef).

steps.t: Teleport with the ring of kinship again and talk to Lord Yudura (with ghostspeak amulet equipped if you haven't completed the hard Morytania achievements).

sub.t: Lord Yudura is located immediately at the teleport location, but may be difficult to see, as he blends into the snow. Using High Contrast Mode can be helpful.

steps.t: Inspect Taevas's corpse and Vengeance's corpse.
Enter the room to the west and take at least the following number from the crates (you can use secondary option to take 5 at a time).
Go two rooms east and set up the ritual site.

sub.t: Place Lord Yudura's corpse on the focus object spot.
Place a greater ritual candle on each of the light source spots.
Draw a glyph on each of the glyph spots.

steps.t: Return west and talk to Lord Yudura.
Kill the skeletal archer, sorcerer, and warrior.
Talk to Death in the City of Um.
